description: A runtime error in a feature condition fails its stage with a grammar result and retains earlier output (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.value.split($.tokens-after-first.value) = ∅
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
```
